Specifically, A. Your firm’s Quality Unit failed to thoroughly investigate, determine root causes, and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions in response to failing sterility test results. For example, but not limited to: • NQE-US59-230502-115 was initiated on May 1, 2023, in response to failing sterility test results for del Nido Formula (Plasmalyte) 1052.8mL, Lot # <Redacted B4>.
